# Fluffy Pet Wash

> Mobile dog and cat grooming that comes to your door in Las Vegas, Henderson, and Orlando.

Fluffy Pet Wash grooms pets at the client's door. Appointments are booked through MoeGo. Payments are processed through MoeGo. This file lists the public pages.

## Services

- [Home](https://www.fluffypetwash.com/): Mobile dog grooming in Las Vegas
- [Services](https://www.fluffypetwash.com/services): What a grooming visit includes
- [Prices](https://www.fluffypetwash.com/prices): Mobile dog grooming prices
- [Cat grooming in Las Vegas](https://www.fluffypetwash.com/cat-grooming-las-vegas): Cat grooming, starting at $120
- [Doodle grooming in Las Vegas](https://www.fluffypetwash.com/doodle-grooming-las-vegas): Doodle and poodle grooming, large doodles starting at $140
- [Orlando](https://www.fluffypetwash.com/orlando): Mobile pet grooming in Orlando, Florida
